# Clean MDM representative fixture v1

All rows and registrations are synthetic. This pinned fixture exercises eight identity kinds, shared Adviser/Audit Firm/Fund profiles, individual Adviser registration, fund shares, issuer/audit/branch/venue/fund-management/holding relationships, and a 13F manager without an Adviser profile. The manifest retains explicit identity allocations and steward decisions for deterministic replay. It is not matching-calibration evidence or an approved production input.
